dashboard_rss_mean_mib.label: Dashboard memory usage
dashboard_rss_mean_mib.note: Application process RSS sampled every 50 ms during the eight-second workload. Dots show average RSS. Excludes child processes and GPU memory.

renderer_fps.label: Present calls per second
renderer_fps.note: Closer to 144 FPS is better, matching my 144 Hz screen.

frame_gap_max_ms.label: Longest present-call gap
frame_gap_max_ms.note: Includes silent periods at both ends of the workload. Lower is better, but does not establish display latency.

dashboard_worst_gap_ms.label: Worst presentation gap
dashboard_worst_gap_ms.note: Longest period without a presentation during the eight-second workload. Worst across runs. Lower is better.

cpu_ms.label: CPU time
cpu_ms.note: CPU consumed during the workload. Less CPU can mean less work completed, not a faster UI.

pss_mib.label: PSS
pss_mib.note: Process-tree proportional memory. Shared pages are apportioned between processes.

frame_gap_p95_ms.label: p95 present-call gap
frame_gap_p95_ms.note: Gaps between present calls, not confirmed display latency. Also inspect the longest gap.

frame_gap_p99_ms.label: p99 present-call gap
frame_gap_p99_ms.note: Gaps between present calls, not confirmed display latency. Also inspect the longest gap.

rss_mib.label: RSS
rss_mib.note: Resident memory at workload end. Shared pages may be counted more than once.

runs.timing: 3s runs × 3 · 1s warm-up · Dashboard interaction: 8s × 1 · four 2s phases · Scroll 7,000 rows: 3s × 3 · 1s warm-up · Scroll 1,000 rows: 3s × 3 · 1s warm-up · Scroll 3,000 rows: 3s × 3 · 1s warm-up · Scroll 5,000 rows: 3s × 3 · 1s warm-up
runs.responsiveness: Scroll 7,000 rows, Scroll 1,000 rows, Scroll 3,000 rows, Scroll 5,000 rows: renderer cadence measured, other workloads inherited. Visible updates unverified

missing.reason: No dashboard frame anchor before the workload
Dashboard capture did not bracket the full eight-second workload
